english.title: Fail to retain records of relevant livestock exported from GB
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were engaged in the export from Great Britain of relevant livestock, namely **(..SPECIFY LIVESTOCK..), and failed to retain a record in respect of the export, namely **(..SPECIFY RECORDS..), for a period of three years from the date the journey was completed
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11 and 15(a) of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Enforcement Regulations 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person engaged in the export of relevant livestock from Great Britain
failed to retain records of journey logs / other documentation / information from navigation system or export health certificate required under regulation 11 of the Animal Welfare (Livestock Exports) Enforcement Regulations 2024
for a period of three years
from the date the journey was completed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 14 for offences by bodies corporate.
(ii) See regulation 16 for the power of prosecution afforded to a local authority.
(iii) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence to show that it was not practicable to keep such a record (regulation 11(5)).
